home.hero_title: Phusao (ຜູ້ສາວ) – ແພລັດຟອມຫາຄູ່ເດດ ແລະ ເດັກເອັນ ອັນດັບ 1 ໃນລາວ ແລະ ໄທ

gdpr.title: GDPR
gdpr.intro: For the purpose of the improved understanding of the Privacy Policy by the consumers, the term "User" has been replaced by/with the term "You", and consequently "Administrator" by/with "We". The term "GDPR" relates to Regulation (Eu) 2016/679 of The European Parliament and of The Council of 27 April 2016 on the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data and on the free movement of such data, and repealing Directive 95/46/EC (General Data Protection Regulation).
gdpr.controller_content: We, at Fiwfan, as the Data Controller care significantly about protection of Your Personal Data and therefore present this Privacy Policy in order to provide a general indication of the adopted rules for the protection of your Personal Data and the rights you are entitled to in relation to their processing.
gdpr.contact_title: Personal Data Controller contact details regarding the protection of personal data
gdpr.contact_content: The person overviewing the processing of personal data following GDPR regulations is accessible via the
gdpr.security_title: The security of the data processing
gdpr.security_content_1: The security of your data is our priority, therefore according to GDPR we have introduced and maintain the organizational and technical means/ adequate to recognized risks. The security measures are regularly reviewed and modified when needed.
gdpr.security_content_2: In order to ensure the integrity and confidentiality of your data, we have introduced the procedures allowing access to data to authorized parties exclusively.
gdpr.form_contact_title: Contact Form (including helpdesk) – the object and the basis of the data processing
gdpr.form_contact_content_1: Your personal data provided through the contact form are processed in order to identify the sender/author of the query as well as to respond to it. Providing us with your personal information is necessary to receive and to respond to your query, and abstaining results in our inability to deliver these services.
gdpr.form_contact_content_2: The legal basis for data processing is its necessity for the performance of the services agreement (Article 6(1)(b) of GDPR).
gdpr.form_advertiser_title: Advertiser registration form – the object and the basis of the data processing
gdpr.form_advertiser_content_1: Your personal data provided through this form are processed in order to register your account on our server.
gdpr.form_advertiser_content_2: Providing us with your personal information is necessary, and abstaining results in our inability to register your account.
gdpr.form_advertiser_content_3: The legal basis for data processing is its necessity for the performance of the services agreement (Article 6(1)(b) of GDPR).
gdpr.form_member_title: Membership account registration form – the object and the basis of the data processing
gdpr.form_member_content_1: Your personal data provided through this form are processed in order to register your membership account on our website. Providing us with your personal information is necessary, and abstaining results in our inability to register your membership account.
gdpr.form_member_content_2: The legal basis for data processing is its necessity for the performance of the services agreement (Article 6(1)(b) of GDPR).
gdpr.form_advertiser_contact_title: The advertiser contact form for the members – the object and the basis of the data processing
gdpr.form_advertiser_contact_content_1: Your personal data provided through this form are processed in order to facilitate direct contact with the advertiser. Providing us with your personal information is necessary to establish contact with the advertiser.
gdpr.form_advertiser_contact_content_2: The legal basis for data processing is its necessity for the performance of the services agreement (Article 6(1)(b) of GDPR).
gdpr.email_corr_title: E-mail correspondence for the purpose of the desired communication – the object and the basis of the data processing
gdpr.email_corr_content_1: Your personal data provided through e-mail correspondence are processed in order to facilitate resolving of the reported issues. Providing us with your personal information is necessary to establish contact with the advertiser.
gdpr.email_corr_content_2: The legal basis for data processing is its necessity for the performance of the services agreement (Article 6(1)(b) of GDPR).
gdpr.newsletter_content_1: Your personal data provided while registering for a newsletter are processed for the purpose of transmitting marketing content. The legal basis for data processing is your consent (Article 6(1)(a) of GDPR).
gdpr.newsletter_content_2: You have the right to withdraw your consent for the data processing at any time. Your withdrawal does not influence the lawfulness of the previous data processing.
gdpr.stats_content_1: Your personal data can also be processed for statistical and analytical reasons in order to improve the quality, functionality of the website, and the services provided therein.
gdpr.stats_content_2: The legal basis for the data processing is a legitimate interest pursued by the Controller (Article 6(1)(f) of GDPR). You have the right to object to this data processing.
gdpr.recipients_content_1: In the light of the activity requiring processing of the personal data, your personal data might be disclosed to third parties, including in particular the providers responsible for technical support for the computer system and for the devices, the marketing agencies, the e-commerce agencies, the accounting services providers.
gdpr.recipients_content_2: Moreover, your data might be disclosed if required by the competent authority or third-parties as long as their request is based on relevant provisions and compliant with existing legislation.
gdpr.transfer_title: Transfer of the personal data outside of the European Economic Area ("EEA")
gdpr.transfer_content: We do not intend to transfer your personal data outside of the EEA, however in case it would be deemed necessary, the transfer will take place exclusively
gdpr.transfer_list_1: in the performance of the standard contractual clauses issued by the European Commission;
gdpr.transfer_list_2: in the performance of the binding corporate rules approved by the competent supervisory authority;
gdpr.transfer_list_3: in cooperation with the parties processing personal data in the countries, in respect of which the European Commission has issued a decision concluding the appropriate personal data protection standards in place
gdpr.retention_title: The period for which the personal data are stored (retention)
gdpr.retention_content_1: In case of the processing on the basis of the legitimate interest pursued by the Controller, your personal data are processed for the period allowing/enabling the exercise of this interest or until the objection to the data processing is effectively filed.
gdpr.retention_content_2: In case of the processing on the basis of your consent, your personal data are processed until you withdraw your consent.
gdpr.retention_content_3: In case of the processing on the basis of their necessity to conclude and perform a contract, your personal data are processed until the contract is terminated.
gdpr.retention_content_4: The period for which the personal data are processed may be prolonged in the event that the processing is necessary to determine or pursue legal claims or to defend against legal claims.
gdpr.rights_title: Rights relating to the processing of personal data
gdpr.rights_intro: You are entitled to the following rights:
gdpr.rights_list_1: the right to information about the processing of personal data
gdpr.rights_list_2: the right to obtain a copy of personal data
gdpr.rights_list_3: the right to modify personal data
gdpr.rights_list_4: the right to delete personal data (the right to be forgotten)
gdpr.rights_list_5: the right to limit the processing
gdpr.rights_list_6: the right to transfer personal data
gdpr.rights_list_7: the right to object to the processing of the personal data for marketing purposes, which means you can at any moment object to the processing of the data for marketing purposes without providing any reason for your objection
gdpr.rights_list_8: the right to object to the processing of the personal data
gdpr.rights_list_9: the right to withdraw your consent for the processing if the processing is based on your consent
gdpr.rights_list_10: the right to file a complaint to the President of the Personal Data Protection Office
gdpr.filing_title: Filing claims and demands to exercise the rights
gdpr.changes_list_1: The current version of the Privacy Policy – as of 1st Dec, 2025
gdpr.changes_list_2: The Policy is subject to a regular review, and modification when required
gdpr.cookies_content_1: An HTTP cookie (browser cookie) is a small piece of data stored on the user's computer by the web browser while browsing a website. Cookies were designed to be a reliable mechanism for websites to remember stateful information (such as items added in the shopping cart in an online store) or to record the user's browsing activity (including clicking particular buttons, logging in, or recording which pages were visited in the past). They can also be used to remember pieces of information that the user previously entered into form fields, such as names, addresses, passwords, and payment card numbers.
gdpr.cookies_purpose_title: The purpose of storing and gaining access to cookies:
gdpr.cookies_purpose_list_1: personalisation of the website (e.g. retaining the preferred font size, the version for the visually impaired, or any color version)
gdpr.cookies_purpose_list_2: retaining user’s data and choices (e.g. reducing the need to enter login and password on every subpage, retaining login next time the site is visited, retaining the content of the cart)
gdpr.cookies_purpose_list_3: customizing the content of the advertisements displayed on the website
gdpr.cookies_purpose_list_4: creating statistics of the website and statistics of the users’ movements between different websites
gdpr.cookies_links_intro: Below you can find direct links to the information indicating how the conditions of storing or gaining access to cookies can be defined in the settings of the most popular internet browsers:
gdpr.cookies_closing: Due to the many different technological solutions in existence, it is not possible to provide complete and precise instructions on how to define the conditions of storing or gaining access to the cookies using the settings and the software on each and every accessible telecommunication device. However, in most cases, it is sufficient to use the „Tools” or „Settings” option and search for the section responsible for the configuration of cookies settings or privacy settings while browsing. More detailed information is usually provided by the manufacturer of a particular device or by the developer of the browser in the browser instructions or on his website.
